description.en: Korean language pack for DeepSeek Harness: 74 dictionaries / 3,843 strings regenerated for DSH 0.2.2-rc.1, scoped Korean font stack, marketplace-ready.
description.ko: 딥시크 하네스 한국어 언어팩: DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 기준 74개 사전 / 3,843개 문자열, 한국어 전용 폰트 스택, 마켓 등록 지원.

release.notes: v0.0.1-rc.1 regenerates the pack against DSH 0.2.2-rc.1: 74 dictionaries / 3,843 strings (7 new rc.1 namespaces translated, 76 keys added, 66 retired keys and 2 retired namespaces removed), with 0 missing, 0 extra and 0 placeholder mismatches against the installed runtime. English README.md remains the default document with a reciprocal Korean README.ko.md; CHANGELOG.md and CHANGELOG.ko.md record the version history.
